data.summary:
**When:** [Opponent's Movement phase](vsdata:core-rule/movement-phase), after an enemy unit finishes a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move), [advance move](vsdata:core-rule/advance-move) or [fall-back move](vsdata:core-rule/fall-back).

**Target:** A **TRANSPORT** unit of yours, other than an **AIRCRAFT** or **TITANIC** unit, that is not in [Engagement Range](vsdata:core-rule/engagement-range) of any enemy unit and is up to 8" from that enemy unit.

**Effect:** The unit can move up to 6" in a [normal move](vsdata:core-rule/normal-move).
